name: hf_openmind
title: OpenMind: head-and-neck 3D MRI pooled from OpenNeuro, one study at a time
description: 114k MRI volumes from 800 OpenNeuro studies, pooled by the nnU-Net group (MIC-DKFZ) for self-supervised pre-training, each with a deface mask and an anatomy mask. The repo holds 266 721 files: listing it whole takes 15 minutes and is rate-limited for anonymous clients, so this manifest scopes the listing to one study (source.paths). pl.load('hf://MIC-DKFZ/OpenMind/OpenMind/ds000003') picks another study; openneuro_metadata.csv at the repo root indexes them all.

license.note: CC BY 4.0 on the Hub card (checked 2026-10-13); each OpenNeuro study keeps its own CC0 / CC BY terms upstream, TO CONFIRM per study before redistribution.

citation: Wald T., Ulrich C., Suprijadi J., et al. An OpenMind for 3D medical vision self-supervised learning. arXiv:2412.17041, 2024.

t1w.description: T1-weighted MRI (NIfTI; LPS mm come from the header once loaded)

t2w.description: T2-weighted MRI when the study has one (inplane T2 in ds000001)

deface_mask.description: Voxels removed by defacing on the T1w image

anatomy_mask.description: Voxels that hold anatomy on the T1w image (fb_mask)
